args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The function docstring and FIN-212 require ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the
implementation was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

Import and use ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the failing nightly build caused by `tests/test_money.py`, which expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212.

## Problem
`src/money.py` documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 but actually quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. As a result, half-cent cases rounded to the nearest cent away from zero instead of to even:
- `2.675` → `2.68` (same either way, test passes)
- `2.665` → `2.67` (wrong; expected `2.66` per banker's rounding)

## Fix
Import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), ...)`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986): **passed**.
